ideas.title: Following the Money in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of child care fraud cases, including Feeding Our Future and other organizations.
questions: How much money is involved in child care fraud?
What are the financial connections between organizations?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover a larger network of fraud and corruption. This story has the potential to expose significant wrongdoing and lead to further investigations.
